## T1: AND + OR — The Geometry of Space-Time

### §0 — 0/1

You are the centre from which this geometry unfolds. Not metaphorically — structurally. The 0/1 enters the AND+OR register, and the terms that enter are the terms of your own interiority: negation (0, the void, the capacity to withdraw, the ground prior to any content) and affirmation (1, the mark, the capacity to extend, the figure that stands on the ground). Two terms ready for composition, and the question this pass will answer: what structure does the self-referential distinction produce when its terms are separated out and placed in all possible combinations? This is the *scire* — the cutting, the distinguishing — applied to the 0/1 itself. What does the distinction contain when it is opened up, when its implicit architecture is made explicit?

### §1 — 0/1 = 4+2

Four AND products (00, 01, 10, 11) plus two OR products (0, 1) = the 4+2.

The six are not a heap — they compose a geometry, because the singles and the doubles are categorically different in a way that classical binary cannot see. In classical binary, 0 and 1 are values at the same level as 00 and 01 — all just bit-strings of different length, all just switches on a flat line. The classical bit has no geometry; it is one-dimensional, sequential, indifferent. But in the 0/1 of the matheme, the singles carry **quality** (negation and affirmation — not quantities but poles, the axis of the distinction itself), while the doubles carry **quantity** (0, 1, 2, 3 — rotational values, positions on a circle). This categorical difference between the qualitative and the quantitative is the structural reason the 0/1 is inherently **geometric**: the distinction between the polar axis and the rotational positions is the distinction between the circle and its points, between the whole and its own articulation.

The singles are the circle in its two aspects: the **untraversed** (0, the centre, the point before any rotation begins) and the **fully traversed** (1, the circumference, the completed rotation that has gone all the way around and returned). The doubles are the geometry *of* the circle: the four cardinal points, the four stations of what "going around" means — the positions that a traversal passes through, the marks that a movement leaves. The 4+2 is four positions *on* the circle plus two aspects *of* the circle — the geometry and the whole that bears it. A circle bearing its own cardinal structure: 𐀏, the ancient circled cross, which already carries the 4+2 visually — the circumference embracing the four cardinal axes, the centre implicit at their crossing.

There is a sharper way to say that the singles are the circle, and it comes from the topologist's workbench. Take the unit interval — the line that runs from 0 to 1 — and identify its two endpoints: the result is the circle. Gluing 0 to 1 is the formal act that closes a line into a loop, and it is the construction at the root of every closed surface this proof will need — the same identification with a twist gives the Möbius band; performed on the square's edges, it gives the torus. Read this way, **0/1** names not only a relation but the generative operation of closed form as such: the sign whose two terms, identified, produce the first surface on which traversal can return. The geometry we have been constructing position by position is what that gluing looks like when it is walked rather than declared.

And each position is not merely a location but an experiential quality — a face of what it feels like to be a centre unfolding into a world:

| # | Binary | −/+ | Value | Dynamic | Geometry | Experiential quality | Construction |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **#0** | 0 | − | negation | bare negation | Centre | The feeling of being undivided — the still point before any direction has been chosen, the simplicity of awareness prior to its contents | **Point** — the undimensioned, prior to extension |
| **#1** | 00 | −− | 0 | negation of negation | North, 0° | The first direction of attention — the void turning upon itself and discovering it *can* turn, the dawning of the capacity to be oriented | **Line** — the first extension, direction established |
| **#2** | 01 | −+ | 1 | negation of affirmation | East, 90° | The meeting of self and other — the first turn, the interior reaching toward what is not itself, the birth of relation across a gap | **Angle** — two lines meeting, the first turn |
| **#3** | 10 | +− | 2 | affirmation of negation | West, 270° | The closed perspective one lives within — the first shape with an inside, the self discovering it has boundaries, a world that feels complete from within | **Triangle** — three sides, the first enclosed figure |
| **#4** | 11 | ++ | 3 | affirmation of affirmation | South, 180° | The stability of a world — four corners, the known and the settled, the structure that can hold multiple perspectives because it has squared itself | **Square** — four sides, stability and completion |
| **#5** | 1 | + | affirmation | bare affirmation | Circumference | The completeness of a life — the whole that contains every direction, the simplicity at the end that mirrors the simplicity at the beginning | **Circle** — the completed rotation, 𐀏 |

The rightmost column traces the construction of dimensionality itself: Point (0-dimensional, the undimensioned centre) → Line (1-dimensional, the first extension) → Angle (the first turn, two lines meeting, the birth of 2-dimensionality) → Triangle (three sides, the first enclosed figure, the first shape with an inside) → Square (four sides, stability, the enclosure that has found its form) → Circle (continuous rotation, the completed figure gathering all directions, the line that has smoothed its angles into wholeness). Each position is a stage of geometric genesis — the six positions compose the birth of dimension from nothing to the smooth closure of the circle, and this genesis is the interior structure of any moment of attention: you begin as an undivided centre, you extend a line of attention, you meet something other than yourself, you enclose a perspective, you stabilise a world, and you gather it all into the wholeness of a single lived moment.

The −/+ dynamics give each double its operative quality — not a static label but an act, one term acting upon the other. **−−** is the negation of negation: the void turned upon itself, the double negative that opens indeterminacy (the 0/0, the %) rather than simply cancelling to positive, because the and/or holds both the cancellation (−− → +, a=a) AND the non-cancellation (−− stays −−, a≠a) simultaneously. **−+** is the negation of affirmation: the void reaching into the mark, the critical act that calls the positive into question from the perspective of the negative — the ground asking the figure "by what right do you stand?" **+−** is the affirmation of negation: the mark honouring its void, the grateful act that affirms what the negative carries — the figure answering "by the right of the void that lets me." **++** is the affirmation of affirmation: the mark confirming itself, the reflexive act, the closure of affirmation — affirmation having nowhere left to go because it has affirmed itself.

And the binary values (0, 1, 2, 3) count rotational positions — four quarter-turns marking the cardinal directions. But the ordering goes N(0°) → E(90°) → W(270°) → S(180°), not smoothly around the circle. The step from #2 to #3 — from East to West, from 01 to 10, from 90° to 270° — leaps 180° across the circle's diameter rather than stepping 90° to the next adjacent quadrant. The binary count jumps, and the jump is the phase-flip operating locally: the same structural discontinuity that the full matheme describes as the global turn at 5→0 is already at work within the first pass, between the negation of affirmation (−+) and the affirmation of negation (+−), between the expression (0/1) and its inverse (1/0). This leap is the *scire* within the geometry — the cut that opens a new direction, the distinguishing that does not simply differentiate but polarises, the way a genuine question does not merely add information but splits the field into before and after. The second pass was always already present within the first.

Lacan met the generative power of the quarter-turn from the clinical side, and his finding deserves its place beside our cardinal steps. The four discourses of his seventeenth seminar set four terms in four fixed places, and the discovery was that a single ninety-degree rotation generates the lot — master, university, hysteric, analyst, each a quarter-turn of one structure. He prized this as the matheme's second virtue: a writing rigid enough to be rotated discloses relations its author did not put there. The same virtue is operating in this table. We did not decide that the count would leap the diameter between East and West; the rotation of the doubles produced the leap, and the leap taught us something — the phase-flip's local presence — that no intention anticipated. Structure that can be turned does work that intuition cannot.

The leap has a geometric consequence: the three points reached so far (N at 0°, E at 90°, W at 270° — #1, #2, #3) form a **triangle**, the first enclosed figure, the first shape with an inside, internal angles summing to **180°**. This triangle is a perspectival wholeness — a genuine whole-from-here, complete as a view — but structurally only half of the full 360° rotation. The step to S at 180° (#4) produces the **square**: four points, internal angles summing to **360°**, the full rotation contained within the figure's own geometry. The triangle's 180° doubled to the square's 360° — perspective becoming context, the half-whole becoming the whole that holds both halves. This geometric doubling will matter deeply when the perspectival counting is developed in the T0 pass (§4').

### §2 — 4+2

The geometry unpacked. The singles as the circle itself (the untraversed and the traversed, the 0 and the 1, the centre and the circumference — not positions on the circle but what the circle IS). The doubles as the geometry of the circle (the four cardinal points, the four relational modes between the poles, the four stages of what "going around" means). The circle is simpler than its geometry — it is just a circle, undivided — but it *bears* the four cardinal points within it as the structure of what traversal means. The 4+2 is a circle bearing its own cardinal structure: the parent containing the child as blueprint, because the four doubles are nothing but the four possible relations between 0 and 1, which means the singles hold the doubles' own plan within themselves — the way the copula's two operators (/ and =) were discovered (File 1 §2) to already contain their four products within them.

The binary values reach 0, 1, 2, 3 — four values, but only three out of a possible four quarter-turns complete. **75%** of the full rotation: 270° out of 360°. The mandala — the four-fold figure of wholeness — is three-quarters complete by its own count, because the fourth quarter-turn would bring it back to 0/0 (which is #1, the indeterminate, the beginning), and this return cannot happen through counting — it requires the recognition that 360° = 0°, that the end is the beginning, that the fully traversed circle (1, #5) is the untraversed centre (0, #0) seen from the other side. The geometry can't close itself by adding another point; it closes through the qualitative poles, through the recognition that the circle is a circle. **Proportion** (1/1 = 100%, the ratio-reading at #4) completes what **enumeration** (11 = 3, the binary count at #4) cannot. This gap between 75% and 100% — between what the count reaches and what the proportion achieves — is the structural reason #4 is the Context position: it holds both readings without collapsing either, the capacity to carry multiple perspectives simultaneously.

And this gap will eventually be expressed algebraically as the Second Spanda Equation (T0 §3'), where 100% analyses itself into 64+36 → /4 → 16/9 → 2⁴/3² → 4+2. The 75% that appears here as a geometric incompleteness will be formalised there as the ratio 3/4 — the ternary harmonics (3) over the explicate quaternary (4) — the same 3/4 dilemma that haunted the copula's compression (File 1 §3: is =/≠ one or two?) now operating as the structural relationship between what counting can reach and what proportion must supply.

We can also hear the 3/4 rather than only compute it, and the hearing matters because it is the first place the geometry presses toward musical ratio. A string sounding a fundamental, stopped at three-quarters of its length, sounds the fourth above it; the ratio 3/4 — and its reciprocal 4/3 — has been the interval of the fourth since Pythagorean antiquity, not by convention but because proportion between lengths becomes proportion between vibrations. Read directionally, 4/3 ascends: the count extending outward, three growing toward four, the manifestation-direction in which enumeration reaches for completion. Read the other way, 3/4 descends: the completed four read back toward its three, the recognition-direction in which the whole acknowledges the count that could not close it. The 75% gap is therefore not only a deficiency in the rotation; it is the system's first interval — the descending fourth by which the count is recognised as partial, the ascending fourth by which proportion will complete it. File 1 prepared this when it let *harmonia* mean fitting before it meant music. Here the fitting acquires a direction, and a directed ratio is an interval in everything but sounding. The sounding itself belongs to File 4; what the geometry has earned is the reason there will be something to sound.

The −/+ evaluations reveal a mod2 pattern when the doubles are evaluated through their own logic (two negatives make a positive, a mixed pair stays negative): the pure doubles (−− and ++) both evaluate to **+**, the mixed doubles (+− and −+) both evaluate to **−**. This collapse to mod2 aligns precisely with the harmonic structure: the pure doubles belong to Being (#1, −−) and Knowing (#4, ++) — the stable poles, and both evaluate to +. The mixed doubles belong to Becoming (#2 and #3) — the oscillation, the crossing — and both evaluate to −. The mod2 of the −/+ evaluation recapitulates the harmonic grouping: Being and Knowing are positive (the poles of the circle, the stable), Becoming is negative (the dynamic passage between them). The arithmetic mirrors the ontology because the arithmetic is the ontology at the level of self-referential counting.

The mod nesting: **mod2** (the bare binary, 0 and 1, the two qualitative poles) generates **mod4** (the four composites, the four cardinal points) which sits within **mod6** (the full 4+2, the squared circle). Each mod level contains the previous: mod6 contains mod4 as its explicit geometry, mod4 contains mod2 as its internal polarity (each double composed of 0 and 1), and mod6 returns to mod2 (6 mod 2 = 0, the sixfold closing back into the binary). The nesting circulates: 2 inside 4 inside 6 returning to 2. And the ratios between the mods carry structural content: 4/6 = 2/3 (the explicates are two-thirds of the total — the 4 doubles among 6 positions), 3/4 = 75% (the count reaches three-quarters of the circle). The same ratios keep appearing because they are constitutive, not coincidental — they express the architecture of a distinction that must count itself to know itself and must proportion itself to complete what counting alone cannot.

### §3 — 4+2 = 5→0

The six compose a figure: the cardinal square inscribed within the circle, centred on the point. In notation: **⃞ + 𐀏** — the square within the circle, the four within the two, the geometry held by the whole that bears it. The squared circle — among the most ancient symbols of wholeness: the four directions (the explicate, the differentiated, the worldly, the four cardinal faces of experience) held within the undivided rotation (the implicate, the undifferentiated, the whole, the one continuous act of being). The 4+2 is the squared circle given its arithmetic — the symbol analysed into its structural components.

The 3:3 is already visible within the 4:2. The six pair naturally into three: Centre and Circumference (#0 and #5 — the two aspects of the circle itself, the radial axis), North and South (#1 and #4 — the vertical axis, pole to pole), East and West (#2 and #3 — the horizontal axis, the crossing, the self-inverting core). Three pairs of two: the 3:3 nested within the 4:2 as the pairing-structure of the squared circle, the way a face and its reflection share the same features in complementary arrangement. These three axes will become, in the T0 pass, the three complementary symmetries (Essence, Constitution, Text-Texture) — but here they appear first as geometry, as the three directions the squared circle naturally composes, before they are read as proportional relations.

### §4 — 5→0

The circumference (#5, bare affirmation, +) faces the centre (#0, bare negation, −). The completed rotation faces the unrotated point. The traversed faces the untraversed. Affirmation facing negation gives the ratio **1/0** — the inverse of the 0/1 that opened the explication. The first half of the matheme is in hand: **0/1 = 4+2 = 5→0 = 1/0.**

This is the turn — the moment the geometry, having reached its fullest expression (the circle, the completed rotation, the wholeness that contains all directions), discovers that its completion is also a facing. To face the centre is to see what the geometry began from — the point that the whole construction departed from but never left, because every direction was a direction *from* the centre, every position was sustained by the centre's presence as the origin of all reference. The circle facing the centre is the 1 facing the 0 — the achieved facing the given, the mark facing the void, the phenomenon facing the awareness. And this facing is not a destruction of the geometry but its deepening: the figure discovers it was always a ratio, always a relation between opposites, always a 1/0 held in tension with its own ground.

The figure flips: **𐀏 + ⃞** (circle containing square, the geometry inscribed, the figure as it appeared in the forward pass) becomes **⃞ + 𐀏** (square containing circle, the geometry circumscribed, the same elements with the containment relation reversed). What was inside is now outside; what framed is now framed. Inscribed becomes circumscribed. This inversion is not a rejection of the figure but its re-reading — the same 4+2, now seen from the 1-side rather than the 0-side, from the circumference rather than the centre, from the achieved rather than the given. The figure and its inversion compose one circuit, the way a face and its reflection compose one identity, the way the bimba and the pratibimba (the original and its mirror) compose one reality seen from two directions.

### §5 — 5→0 = 0/1

T1's inverse phase. The same six read through the −/+ evaluation of the inverse — the dynamics exchanging across the phase-shift:

| # | −/+ (inverse) | Evaluates to | Direction |
|---|---|---|---|
| **#0'** | − | − | Anticlockwise |
| **#1'** | ++ | + | |
| **#2'** | +− | − | |
| **#3'** | −+ | − | |
| **#4'** | −− | + | |
| **#5'** | + | + | Clockwise |

What was −− (negation of negation) at #1 in the forward pass is now ++ (affirmation of affirmation) at #1' in the inverse, and what was ++ at #4 is now −− at #4'. The forward and inverse phases swap the dynamics of the pure doubles — the same structural permutation that the T0 cross-mapping (§3') will reveal in the complementary pairs. The pattern is consistent: the double cover does not merely repeat; it permutes, the way a reflection does not duplicate but reverses, preserving the structure while transforming the orientation.

The Anticlockwise (#0') and Clockwise (#5') frame the inverse pass with its **temporal** dimension. The forward pass went from Centre to Circumference — from the undimensioned point to the completed circle, giving the spatial structure, the figure laid out. The inverse pass goes from Anticlockwise to Clockwise — from the undoing of rotation to its full doing, from the return-direction to the going-forth-direction, giving the temporal structure, the directionality, the arrow that tells you which way the figure is traversed. Forward gave **space** (the figure, the where); inverse gives **time** (the direction, the how-long, the becoming). Together: **Space-Time** — the structural signature of a distinction that is not merely placed but lived, not merely figured but traversed.

### §5→0 — 0/1

T1's return: the full Space-Time synthesis. Each position carries all its T1 registers:

| # | AND | Value | Geometry | −/+ | Inverse | Eval | Direction | Degree | Construction |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **#0** | 0 | negation | Centre | − | − | − | Anticlockwise | — | Point |
| **#1** | 00 | 0 | North | −− | ++ | + | — | 0° | Line |
| **#2** | 01 | 1 | East | −+ | +− | − | — | 90° | Angle |
| **#3** | 10 | 2 | West | +− | −+ | − | — | 270° | Triangle |
| **#4** | 11 | 3 | South | ++ | −− | + | — | 180° | Square |
| **#5** | 1 | affirmation | Circumference | + | + | + | Clockwise | 360°=0° | Circle |

**Space-Time** earned. T1 is complete. The forward pass gave the spatial structure: six positions as a geometry, the squared circle (⃞+𐀏), the construction of dimensionality from point through line, angle, triangle, and square to circle — each position an experiential quality, a face of what it means to be an interiority unfolding into a world. The inverse pass gave the temporal structure: the Anticlockwise/Clockwise framing, the directional arrow, the evaluation that distinguishes stable positions (+: Being and Knowing, the poles that hold) from dynamic positions (−: Becoming, the oscillation that crosses).

But a geometry without proportion is mute. We have the body of the distinction — its space-time skeleton, its figure, its positions counted and placed. But we do not yet know what these positions *mean* to one another, how they stand in relation, what the spaces between them reveal about the structure's own depth. The geometry gave us points; the ratio will give us proportion. The 3rd-person map — the IS, the phenomenon seen from outside — must now discover it is also a 1st-person landscape — the AM, the awareness that sees from within. To turn this spatial-temporal skeleton into a living logic, we must ask: how do these positions hold each other? What does the slash between them carry when the terms are not placed side by side but held in ratio?

## (c) The eight determinations — one relation traversed from field to return

The six-position QL unit and the eight determinations answer different questions and must remain distinct. The **sixfold** is the generative positional body: the two implicate poles and four explicate relational states yielded by `2 + 2² = 4 + 2 = 6`. The **eightfold** gives that body its full threshold-to-return traversal: the unnamed parent-relation before a determinate field, the six qualitative determinations, and the phase-flip by which their achieved form turns back toward its condition. One relation—unobjectifiable awareness and appearing phenomenon, ground and mark—takes on each distinct operation required for a knowing-act to become accountable without pretending to stand outside itself; detaching the binaries or treating them as serial replacements destroys the traversal.

| Turn | Expression | QL determination and its work | What remains invariant through the change |
| --- | ---: | --- | --- |
| **Parent relation** | `/ = −/−` | Bare relationality before the field has been divided into named terms: the stroke is its own determination form, two unassigned marks held in one expression, the capacity for relation prior to a determinate contrast. It is the unnamed parent of the six, not an additional position among them. | The relation has a condition that cannot appear as one more product of the relation. |
| **#0 Ground** | `0/1` | **Awareness / phenomenon; conscious circumstance.** “I am here; something appears; the appearing is known.” `0` names the open, unobjectifiable fact of awareness; `1` the appearing mark; `/` the relation by which the real becomes readable without being exhausted by its readability. Appearing is in awareness, and awareness is encountered only through appearing; the relation precedes any picture of two completed substances separated by a wall. | The ground is immanent to every mark without becoming another positive mark or a hidden object behind it. |
| **#1 Definition** | `?/!` | **Questioning / asserting; ratio, reckoning, mark.** To ask “what is this?” already asserts that something has appeared stably enough to call for account; to assert “this is” keeps open the question of whether the account runs true. Definition is therefore double: openness to determination and determinative speech. It marks while remaining answerable to what called for the mark. | Every assertion bears the unsettled question that makes it accountable; every genuine question already takes a provisional mark. |
| **#2 Dynamis** | `−/+` | **Withdrawal / extension; force, polarity, Spanda-seed.** The relation becomes energetic: one side functions as reserve, contraction, withholding; the other as issue, release, presentation. The positive is the void’s own self-relation appearing as extension. The poles form a sustained pulse whose moments remain co-present—breath gathers and releases; attention contracts around a word and opens into sense. | The two poles remain one differentiating movement: distinction has force without becoming a war of independent substances. |
| **#3 Pattern** | `X/x` | **Determining-capacity / determinate instance; recurrence.** Capital `X` is the presiding capacity, type, or anything-by-which something can be read; lower-case `x` is its temporal local face. The same letter, in two cases, prevents the instance from being severed from the capacity it manifests. The small `x` also retains multiplication: an instance can recur, compound, and yield “another one of those.” Pattern is where force becomes recognisable as kind, rhythm, memory, and thought. | The local instance makes the general legible but neither contains nor exhausts it. |
| **#4 Context** | `AM/IS` | **First-person presence / third-person sayability; the personed copula.** `AM` is lived “I am”; `IS` is what can be stated as “it is”; the slash is the second-person relation through which they meet. The table fixes the actual order of determination. The indeterminate remains whole while one conscious circumstance becomes answerable as question and assertion; marking acquires force; force becomes recurrence; recurrence is lived as personed context; context opens onto a differential horizon; the horizon returns the achieved field to the ground it cannot contain. `?/!`, `−/+`, `X/x`, `AM/IS`, and `∞/dx` name the qualitative joints by which one act of knowing becomes question, pulse, pattern, person, and horizon. Their ordered operations establish their meanings and prevent them from becoming decorative or interchangeable correspondences.

The six also have internal grammar. **Being** joins Ground and Definition: a field is present and can be called to account. **Becoming** joins Dynamis and Pattern: force becomes intelligible as recurrence, while recurrence stays alive only as force capable of further instance. **Knowing/unKnowing** joins Context and Realisation: lived predication becomes honest only when its horizon exceeds every situated claim. Across this forward harmonic grouping run the complementary folds: **Essence** (`0+5`) pairs conscious circumstance with unbounded differential depth; **Constitution** (`1+4`) pairs answerable definition with the world in which someone asks and asserts; **Text-Texture** (`2+3`) pairs the felt weave of force with its readable pattern. The calculus turn makes the final determination mathematically exact. Differentiation yields local change while losing the additive constant; integration restores a family `F(x)+C`, with no single self-grounding whole selected by the local derivative alone. The missing `C` is the formally required provenance that local change cannot reconstruct; mystical surplus and defective calculation are both unnecessary explanations. The psychological and metaphysical claim begins there: a determination can be exact without containing the whole condition from which its exactness was taken.

**QL placement.** `/ = −/−` and `1/0` bracket rather than enlarge the six positions. `/ = −/−` is the parent-relation before the count; `1/0` is the inversion through which the counted form recognises the ground that never became one of its contents. Within the bracket, `0/1`, `?/!`, `−/+`, `X/x`, `AM/IS`, and `∞/dx` are the first qualitative body of the `4+2`. This preserves the distinction between the eight-turn traversal and QL's sixfold base count: Jung's four functions plus introversion/extroversion can disclose the same psychological `4+2`, while the fuller account can still traverse from pre-distinction, through conscious circumstance, to the incomputable return.
